projects.details:
The City of Palm Coast wastewater collection system utilizes pretreatment effluent pumping (PEP) in various areas throughout the city. projects.title: Belle Terre Pkwy. Safety Improvements
projects.status: Official project listed; physical construction status not verified
projects.details:
The Belle Terre Parkway Safety Improvements Project, undertaken by the City of Palm Coast, includes traffic, safety, and access management enhancements along approximately two miles of the Belle Terre corridor, extending from 650 feet south of Royal Palms Parkway to 90 feet north of Pritchard Drive. The project encompasses key intersections at Pritchard Drive, Whippoorwill Drive, Pine Grove Drive/Whiteview Drive, Ponce Deleon Drive, Point Pleasant Drive, Royal Palms Drive, and Rymfire Drive. Improvements consist of roadway milling and resurfacing; construction of full-depth turn lanes; installation of traffic separators, curb and gutter, sidewalks, driveways, and detectable warning surfaces; and comprehensive drainage upgrades including inlets, manholes, pipes, and mitered end sections. The project also includes utility relocations for Florida Power & Light infrastructure, as well as significant signalization enhancements such as mast arms, conduit systems, fiber optic and signal cabling, controllers, pedestrian and vehicular signals, and detection systems. Additional features include guardrail, handrail, concrete and reinforced walls, pavement markings, signage, and various ancillary construction activities such as maintenance of traffic, erosion control, excavation, embankment, and sod installation to support overall corridor improvements.
Agency record status (not confirmation of physical completion): Board Authorized
